what: Delegation of the owner of E2A Basketball to the Tactical Studio scheduled task to schedule, WITHOUT per-video review, the tactical videos defined in scope. Only valid when status is 'granted', it is on main, and its sha256 equals the one pinned in the scheduled task's prompt.
never: content that is not a Tactical3DV2 episode
revocation: Immediate and hard: disable or delete the scheduled task 'E2A — TACTICAL STUDIO' on claude.ai. Also: any edit of this file on main (e.g. revoked=true) changes its sha256 and stops publishing at the next check. The task's cron only fires inside these dates.
